newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybeans set contract highs as funds buy.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybeans set contract highs as funds buy.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures set contract highs in the May, July, August, September, January and March contracts as funds continue to buy, traders said.
May jumped to a fresh high of $8.30 per bushel and July to $8.29-1/2.
"Iowa Grain bought one million (bushels) May, Merrill Lynch bought 1.5 million May," a trader said. "Funds keep buying. It's another explosive day."
Floor sources said both buy stops and sell stops were placed above $8.28 per bushel in the May, the level of the previous contract high set on July 12.
Contract highs were also notched in soymeal for the second straight day. The new high for the most-active May soymeal contract is $264.90 a ton, topping the high of $263.50 set on Thursday.
At 1040 CST, soybeans were up eight to 1-1/2 cents per bushel with May up 7-1/4 at $8.29-1/2. Soymeal was up $6.50 yo $0.50 per ton with May up $2.60 at $265.30.
